content: Ketsutsi kemɨranukuke mɨkite watsata
Merikɨtsɨ mexɨakame tukariyaritsie tsemanayaritsie Mariya Mararatanaka teukiyapa kaninuani yuimuana 'uyɨwikaku 'akuxi, tete teukiyapa heuhɨiyakame kaniuxeiya hɨxiena meukatei.

Hikɨ 'unautsarɨmetɨ kaneyani, Tsimuni Pekuru hetsɨa kaninuani meta xeime hetsɨa tiyɨ'ɨkitɨwame Ketsutsi minaki'eriekai hetsɨa, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Ti'aitame teukiyapa mekaniwayekweni, 'atsitepɨkatemate hakewa memeite.
Hikɨ Pekuru kaneyani xewitɨ tiyɨ'ɨkitɨwame hamatɨa, teukiyapa mekanekɨne.
Yu'aurie me'uhutɨ mekaniunautsaxɨaximekaitɨni. Xewitɨ tiyɨ'ɨkitɨwame matsi waɨkawa kaniutanautsa, Pekuru kananuku'iwa, kanaye'ani mɨkɨmeri teukiyapa.
'Anahuka kanixeiya 'ixurikite mana 'akateme, peru muwa pɨkaheutaha.
Hikɨ Tsimuni Pekuru 'utɨmanake kaninuani, teukiyata kaneutahani. 'Ixurikite kaniuxeiya mana 'akateme.
Tuwaxata kaniuxeiya mu'uya mɨ'eimekai 'ixurikite 'aurie pɨkatikatei, yateewa pɨta pɨtikatei tunitɨ.
'Anaketa kaneutahani tiyɨ'ɨkitɨwame 'umexɨatɨ munua teukiyapa, hikɨ 'ixeiyaka, yuri katiniuta'erieni.
Mɨkɨ 'akuxi mepɨkaheitimaiwawekai 'utɨarika meuyewekaikɨ mɨkite watsata manukukeni maine.
Matsiɨkɨtɨ kemɨrayuyeitɨa Ketsutsi Mariya Mararatanaka hɨxie
Hikɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete yukie mekanekɨne,
merikɨtsɨ Mariya teukiya hɨxie kaniutiwekaitɨni takwa 'utatsuatɨ. Hikɨ 'utatsuatɨ kananahuni teukiyata kaneutaniere,
mana kaniwaruxeiya niuki tuayamete yuhutame me'anakatuxame. Xewitɨ Ketsutsi mu'uya manukatei kanakateitɨni, xewitɨta manuka'ɨkakai rakatei hakewa Ketsutsi kaxarieya manutekiekai.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —¿Neuxei, 'ukaratsi, titayari petiutatsuaka? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Neti'aitɨwame mepekwei, 'atsinepɨkatimate hakewa memeite.
Mɨpaɨ 'utayɨka ta'aurie kanaweni, hikɨ Ketsutsi kaniuxeiya mana 'utiweme, matsi 'atsipɨkatimaikai xɨka Ketsutsi hɨkɨtɨkaitɨni.

Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —¿Neuxei, 'ukaratsi, titayari petiutatsuaka? ¿Kepaikɨ pepɨrakuwaune? Mɨkɨ harawerikame 'erietɨ mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Neuxei, 'uki, xɨka 'ekɨ peheikweni, kenetineutaxatɨa hakewa pepeihɨa. Neri nekanenukweimɨkɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Mariya 'aku. Mɨkɨ hepana 'aniereka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe 'arameu niukiyarikɨ: —Xawuni (taniukikɨ Ti'ɨkitame manuyɨne).

Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Pepɨkanetsikuwiwiyani, ne'ukiyari hetsɨa nepɨka'anutiyeiwe 'akuxi. Matsi ne'iwama wahetsɨa kenemie. Mɨpaɨ ketiniwaretahɨawi: “Ne'ukiyari hetsɨa mɨxe'ukiyari hetsɨa nekananutiyeimɨkɨ, nekakaɨyari hetsɨa mɨxekakaɨyari hetsɨa neranutiyanita”.
Hikɨ Mariya Mararatanaka mana kaninuani teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mɨpaɨ tiwakuxaxatɨwatɨ: «Ti'aitame muxeikɨ», mɨpaɨ mɨrehɨawekaikɨ.
Matsiɨkɨtɨ kemɨrayuyeitɨa Ketsutsi teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete wahɨxie

Merikɨtsɨ 'akayuneku mɨkɨ mexɨakame tukariyari tsemanayaritsie, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete meyuxeɨriekaku kiteniete reunatɨkaikaku memɨwamakaxekaikɨ huriyutsixi, Ketsutsi kaninuani. Wahixɨapa kaniutakeni, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xɨka xeka'uximatɨarieka yu'iyaritsie.
Mɨpaɨ 'utayɨka kaniwaruxeitsitɨani yumamate meta yu'aki. Teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mekaniyutemamawiekaitɨni Ti'aitame mexeiyatɨ.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi tawarita mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xɨka xeka'uximatɨarieka yu'iyaritsie. Ne'ukiyari mɨnereyenɨ'a hepaɨ, neta mɨpaɨ nekatinixeheutanɨ'axɨani.
Mɨpaɨ 'utayɨka kaniwaruhɨtsieni, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xekeneutanaki'eri 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata.
Tsepa kemɨ'ane xemɨtewareuyehɨwirieni tita 'axamemɨteyurie, mekateneuyehɨwiyariekuni. Tsepa kemɨ'ane xemɨkateheuyehɨwiri tita 'axamemɨteyurie, mepɨkateheuyehɨwiyarieni.
Tumaxi yuri kemɨkati'eriekai
Merikɨtsɨ Tumaxi Kwate mɨtitewakai tamamata heimana yuhutame wahetsɨa mieme kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni. Mɨkɨ wahamatɨa pɨka'uyeikakai kepauka Ketsutsi munua.

Hikɨ hipatɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mɨpaɨ mekatenikuxaxatɨwakaitɨni: —Ti'aitame tekaniuxeiya. Tumaxi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xɨka mamayatsie neka'ixeiyani kɨrapuxi 'uxayari, xɨka ne'itɨwamekɨ neka'imayɨani kɨrapuxi 'uxayari, meta 'akieya xɨka nemamakɨ neka'umayɨani, yuri nepɨkatita'erieniri.

Merikɨtsɨ 'atahairieka tukari 'anukayaku tawarita teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama kiita mekanayetekaitɨni, Tumaxi wahamatɨa kanayekateitɨni. Hikɨ kiteniete reunatɨkaikaku Ketsutsi kaninuani, wahixɨapa kaniutakeni, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xɨka xeka'uximatɨarieka yu'iyaritsie.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ Tumaxi katiniutahɨawe: —Kenaye'a, 'a'itɨwamekɨ keneneumayɨa nemamatetsie, 'amamakɨ keneneumayɨani ne'akita. Yuri pekati'erietɨ pepɨka'ayuyeitɨwani, matsi pɨta yuri peti'erietɨ kenaye'a.
Tumaxi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Neti'aitɨwame meta nekakaɨyari 'aku.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Yuri pepɨtiuta'eri pemɨnetsi'uxeikɨ. Mɨkɨ memɨkanetsixeiyawawe peru yuri memɨte'erie, mɨkɨ mekaniyutemamawieka.
Merikɨte, 'inɨari yɨkɨ 'aneneme mɨireme yakatiniyurienekaitɨni Ketsutsi teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete wahɨxie, kemɨkare'utɨarie 'ikɨ xapatsie.
Peru 'ikɨ kanaka'utɨarieni yuri xemɨte'eriekakɨ kename Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu hɨkɨ, Kakaɨyari Nu'aya, yuri xete'erietɨ tukari xemexeiyanikɨ hetsɨana xemiemetetɨtɨ.
